text: Objectives The major is to educate the students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks. Duration of Study The study of CS&T program lasts 4 years in all and is composed of two periods. The first period of teaching and the last six months is for the students’ practice.Laboratory ofShenyang Aerospace University
